scope: Derived2D shape previews, not runtime screenshots/new paintings
renderContract: RuneGemView.Icon/Piece(board=null,selected=false,type=0,state=stored), current painted PNG/UV and exact axial geometry/storage default rotation
paletteQualification: Attack palette example only; shape IDs support five types and no type is assigned by shape

presentation.framingOnlyPoints: Retired 9x9 type-emblem corners preserve prior Wiki body scale/centre; never rendered or texture-sampled

framing: Rendered geometry plus retired exterior type-emblem corner bounds define framingBounds with24px Wiki padding; geometryBounds describes rendered geometry only; original cell-based game FitIcon is unchanged
gpuDifferences: Source PNG vs Unity imported/compressed texture
CPU sRGB blend/bilinear/supersample vs GPU color-space/shader sampling
Wiki framing uses framingBounds including retired-emblem corners, not original FitIcon crop
The offset outer glint is omitted for derived presentation; the retired exterior type emblem is absent from both current runtime and previews

frame.sampling: CPU bilinear,2x supersampling,LANCZOS downsample; sRGB alpha blend; not GPU-compressed pixels
